payload_cleanup_command:
dir=/var/tmp/openaev-created-art
if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ ! -L "$dir" ] && [ "$(stat -c %u "$dir")" = 0 ]; then
  if [ -f "$dir/uid" ] && [ ! -L "$dir/uid" ] && [ "$(id -u art 2>/dev/null)" = "$(cat "$dir/uid")" ]; then
    userdel art
  fi
  rm -rf "$dir"
fi
payload_description: Create a local account named art with the password art, its home in a directory of the run's own, switch to it to run whoami, then remove both: an account named art that already exists, or anything already where the run keeps its state, is left as it is, and nothing is created.
